name: Stitch Skills
what: A collection of agent skills and plugins for Google Stitch, Google's AI design tool, published by Google Labs. They work through the Stitch MCP server and come in three plugins: stitch-design (generate and edit screens from text or images, turn existing frontend code into a Stitch design, extract or apply a DESIGN.md design system), stitch-build (turn Stitch screens into React or React Native components, build walkthrough videos with Remotion, shadcn/ui guidance) and stitch-utilities (improve rough UI prompts, write DESIGN.md and SITE.md files, build multi-page sites in a loop). Skills follow the open Agent Skills format. The README notes it is not an officially supported Google product. Apache-2.0 licensed.
who: People who design app screens in Stitch and want their coding agent to create designs there or turn them into working React code.

setup.text: First set up the Stitch MCP server in your agent by following Google's Stitch MCP setup instructions (stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup). The skills need it to work.
Claude Code (installs into the current project):
setup.code: npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code
npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope workspace --target cursor

setup.text: Codex: add the marketplace, then install stitch-design, stitch-build or stitch-utilities:
setup.code: codex plugin marketplace add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --ref main

setup.text: To pick individual skills instead, run npx skills add google-labs-code/stitch-skills. Some skills depend on others, so include their dependencies. OpenCode needs a manual copy of the skill folders; the README explains how.

prompts: Generate a mobile settings screen in Stitch with a dark mode toggle and notification preferences.
Scan /src and extract our design system into .stitch/DESIGN.md.
Convert the screens in my Stitch project into React components that use our design tokens.
